beats.narration: Reentry is not one checklist. Identification, employment, housing, and transportation can depend on one another. Pathfinder turns Confirmed Facts into a Route. Here, the Focus Action is to obtain a state identification card because it is a hard prerequisite that unlocks three next steps.

beats.narration: When I mark it complete, the deterministic Route Engine recalculates. This Reroute shows a new focus, all three Actions that became available, and the work that moved, so the participant can see exactly why the Route changed.

Proposed Facts don't affect your Route until you confirm them.

beats.narration: Pathfinder preserves every change in Route History, works on mobile, and is production deployed with automated tests across the engine, APIs, security boundaries, and user journey. I built it as a forward-deployed response to a reentry bottleneck, and I am seeking mission-aligned pilot partners.
